dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white with subtle light-grey median tones on the posterior dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse, light-grey pigmented clusters located on the posterior third of the visible trunk.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light-grey pigmented regions and the depigmented white baseline.

other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast dark oval aperture corresponding to the blowhole visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
